messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Trigger: error-rate > 8% for 3m. Paging oncall: @mira-oncall.

mira-oncall: I’m on it. seeing 502/503 spikes in the last 4m. Pulling logs from the serving fleet.

alex-sre: FYI I'm nearby if you want a hand. Any rollback available?

mira-oncall: Not yet. Errors look like backend model process OOM on some pods, others are healthy. Probable memory regression after last kernel update on dedicated hosts.

sarah-cs: Heads-up — are customers impacted? any downstream webhooks failing? CS is getting pings from 3 customers (acme, medlytics, commerce7).

mira-oncall: Yes, partial impact. 15% of requests hitting quantized model pool are returning 502. Global routing still serving from fallback variants but increased latency. Region=us-west-2 primarily.

tyler-support: Can we get a short customer-facing blurb I can paste into Zendesk/Intercom?

mira-oncall: Draft for CS: "We're investigating intermittent 502/503 errors for text generation in US-West. Some requests are failing while automated fallbacks are reducing overall availability. Engineers are diagnosing a memory regression. We'll update shortly. (no action required from you)"

sarah-cs: Nice — can you add ETA and status page line?

mira-oncall: Add: "ETA: next update in 20 minutes. Impact: intermittent generation failures for a subset of requests in US-West. Status page: https://status.redwoodinference.com — incident ID RW-2026-17654"

jason-product: Please include note: "No user data exposure suspected. Model outputs retried on fallback models to preserve UX where possible."

mira-oncall: Included. Also preparing internal comms and a quick triage checklist for support.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RW-2026-17654 created by mira-oncall — Priority: P1 — Impact: partial regional outage — Incident channel: #incidents/1765436789 — runbook: /runbooks/generate-502

mira-oncall: Internal comms (for execs):
- TL;DR: Memory regression after kernel package update caused intermittent OOMs on quantized model pool in us-west-2; ~15% of generation requests returned 502/503; fallbacks mitigated some traffic. Engineers rolling back kernel patch on affected hosts.
- Current state: mitigation in progress (rollback started).
- Customer impact: some latency and failed generations for a subset of customers in us-west; no data exposure.
- Next update: +20m or on milestone.

ops-lead: Good. Add: "estimated MTTI 30-45m, will pursue emergency rollback and pod recycle; standby for postmortem owner."

mira-oncall: Assigned postmortem owner: alex-sre.

alex-sre: Got it. I'll own the RCA and follow up with timeline.

mira-oncall: Troubleshooting checklist for Support/Zendesk agents (pasteable macro):

---- SUPPORT CHECKLIST (agent macro) ----
1) Verify customer's region and model variant. Ask: "Which region and model are you calling? Example: us-west-2 / redwood-rlhf-7b-quant"
2) Check customer request id in logs. Command (infra-bot helper): `infra-bot fetch-req <request-id>`
3) Run quick curl to endpoint and capture status:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate
```
4) If 502/503 seen, escalate with trace + request-id to oncall: `@mira-oncall` and include `incident-id RW-2026-17654`.
5) If customer is blocked, provide workaround: switch to region eu-west-1 or use fallback model `redwood-rlhf-7b-fallback` until we resolve.
6) If they report data loss or unexpected outputs, create a priority ticket and tag `security` and `sre`.
---- END MACRO ----

tyler-support: I'll paste this as a Zendesk macro and include the canned message above. Draft Zendesk reply:
"Hi — thanks for flagging. We're aware of intermittent generation errors in US-West and engineers are rolling a fix. In the meantime you can route requests to eu-west-1 or use `redwood-rlhf-7b-fallback`. We'll follow up within 20 minutes with an ETA. Incident RW-2026-17654. — Tyler (Support)"

sarah-cs: Add link to status page and a short escalation line: "If this is blocking production, reply and we'll prioritize a dedicated patch."

mira-oncall: Status page update draft (to post on status system):
"Summary: Intermittent 502/503 errors observed for text generation in US-West (RW-2026-17654). Impact: a subset of requests may fail or experience elevated latency. Current status: investigating — mitigation in progress (rollback of recent kernel update). Next update: in 20 minutes. Workaround: route traffic to eu-west-1 or use fallback model."

jason-product: Also include CDN/cache note? If customers are caching prompts, mention no cache invalidation required.

mira-oncall: Added: "No cache invalidation required; retries will hit fallback models automatically."

infra-bot: Rolling restart command queued on affected hosts: `infra-bot restart-hosts --tag us-west-2-quantized --limit 4 --wait` — starting in 90s.

alex-sre: When rolling, ensure we keep concurrency low to avoid saturating fallback pool. Suggested batching throttle: `max_concurrency=16` per host.

mira-oncall: Noted. I'll coordinate with infra to throttle.

sarah-cs: Quick Intercom snippet for automated messages to workspace admins:
"We’re currently investigating intermittent generation errors in US-West. Some requests may fail; our engineers are rolling a fix. If you rely on low-latency generation in US-West, consider switching to eu-west-1 temporarily. For immediate help, reply to this message and include Incident ID RW-2026-17654."

ops-lead: Next oncall after Mira is `alex-sre`. Mira, please handoff at +45m if unresolved. Include list of affected hosts and actions performed.

mira-oncall: Will do. Handoff checklist to include:
- Incident ID, timeline of changes, list of affected host IDs, rollback status, logs (link), mitigation steps performed, customer list impacted, postmortem owner.

tyler-support: Macro created in Zendesk: "RW-2026-17654 — Generation errors in US-West — suggested reply" — pushing to team.

mira-oncall: Quick status: rollback started on 6/20 hosts, error rate dropped from 8.7% -> 3.1% for those hosts. Continuing rollout.

incident-bot: UPDATE RW-2026-17654 — mitigation in progress — rollback started — next update +20m.

sarah-cs: Thanks everyone — CS will monitor incoming tickets and prioritize customers flagged as P0.

alex-sre: I'll draft the timeline and own the postmortem. If rollback completes and error rate stays <1% for 30m, we can move to monitoring and postmortem.

mira-oncall: Thanks team. I'll post final handoff at +45m if unresolved.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RW-2026-17654 — channel archived when resolved.
